title: Minecraft: Ultra Revitalized
body:
# Minecraft: Ultra Revitalized

**Yet another Minecraft semi-realism/quality-of-life modpack.**

This modpack contains various mods that enhances visuals, gameplay, and mechanics of the game.
It also contains new blocks, new mobs, new visuals, and improved performance. 
This modpack is intended for players who want a close-to-vanilla experience while also playing something realatively new.

This modpack may require a beefy PC to run it.
